Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3845; not passing away, i.e. untransferable (perpetual):-- unchangeable.
BiblicalUsage: This word describes a priesthood that cannot be passed on to anyone else, because Jesus lives forever. No successor is needed, and none will ever take his place.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this is why my hope is safe: the priest who stands for me never dies and never retires.
